feature: Commanders place: For you, Discover and Help me choose on one strip (menu and Home line, plan 2026-10-22-menu-home.md, PR 1)
note: Photographed over the audit account on a server with COMMANDERS_PLACE_ENABLED, HELP_ME_CHOOSE_ENABLED and NO_COLLECTION_ENTRY_ENABLED on. Each tab is its own row at both widths; the two retired addresses are rows too, because a redirect that never lands leaves the cell empty. The strip is the Collection place's, extracted (`shares`). The two door rows wait on an href that names the tab, so a door still pointing at the retired address fails to be reached.

shares.note: Collection and Commanders draw one strip; each place's head owns its title and trailing controls.

rows.label: /commanders, For you: title and count line (desktop), the strip, then today's ranked page
/commanders/discover, Discover: the same strip with Discover lit; no Help me choose door on the rack
/commanders/choose, Help me choose: the intake form under the strip, with no back-to-New-deck link
/discover with a query: lands on the Discover tab, query kept
/decks/new/choose with a query: lands on the Help me choose tab, query kept
/decks/new, Not sure what to build?: the door lands on the Help me choose tab, with no hop through the old address
/commanders/choose, History: its link stays on the tab (phone only: from lg History is a column beside the form)
